_notes: M31 spec v1 (2026-05-14 Stage 2 onboarding).
Source: session_artifacts/M31/01c_field_analysis.md (authoritative mechanism).
Paytable byte-locked from Stage 2 per ONBOARDING_PROCESS §1.1 universal rule.
Machine type — 3-reel 3-row 5-payline classic with multiplier wilds + FreeSpin:
- Grid: 3 cols x 3 rows, 5 paylines (center, top, bottom, diagonal-down, diagonal-up)
- 4 wild tiers: Wild2x(x2), Wild3x(x3), Wild5x(x5), Wild10x(x10)
- Tier A: regular symbol pays (base x wild_mult_product on payline)
- Tier B: pure wild pays (fixed credits, NOT multiplied by wild_mult)
- Scatter: 3 Scatter anywhere in grid triggers 5000 credits + 7 FreeSpin rounds
- FreeSpin: ST=44, 7 per trigger, reel_set=freespin (reel 2 = 100% wilds)
- No retrigger (Scatter absent from freespin reel set)
Pay_id map (production-verified from rawdata, 0 errors in 12,998 single-payline rounds):
Tier B — pure wild (fixed credits, NOT multiplied by wild_mult):
pay_id 1  — 3x Wild5x, 30000 credits (30x bet)
pay_id 2  — 3x Wild3x, 15000 credits (15x bet)
pay_id 3  — 3x Wild2x, 5000 credits (5x bet)
pay_id 4  — any 3 wilds including Wild10x, 10000 credits (10x bet)
pay_id 5  — any 3 wilds including Wild5x (no Wild10x), 3000 credits (3x bet)
pay_id 6  — any 3 wilds from {Wild2x, Wild3x} only, 600 credits (0.6x bet)
Tier A — regular symbol pays (base credits x wild_mult_product):
pay_id 7  — 3x High7, base 1600 credits (1.6x bet)
pay_id 8  — 3x bell,  base 1200 credits (1.2x bet)
pay_id 9  — 3x 3bar,  base 600 credits (0.6x bet)
pay_id 10 — 3x 2bar,  base 200 credits (0.2x bet)
pay_id 11 — 3x 1bar,  base 100 credits (0.1x bet)
Scatter:
pay_id 12  — 3 Scatter anywhere, 5000 credits fixed
pay_id 666 — 3 Scatter trigger marker, 0 credits (FreeSpin trigger)
Q6 decision (multiplier units): Using credits-absolute values in spec multiplier.
The plugin evaluates Tier A as: win = base_credits * wild_mult_product.
Spec multiplier field = base_credits for Tier A pays.
For Tier B pays: multiplier = fixed_credits (not x-bet fraction).
Bet amount = 1000 credits. So 100 credits = 0.1x bet.
Engine computes: PayResult.multiplier * bet_amount for single-payline machines.
M31 plugin overrides: computes credits directly to avoid float precision issues.
Q1 decision (pure_wild_group alternatives): enumerate all alternatives explicitly.
pay_id 4 includes Wild10x×3 (Q2/Q3 default: falls under pay_id=4 fixed 10000).
Architecture: Option B (FeaturePlugin). Multi-payline + FreeSpin reel-set switch
handled in machines/M31/plugins/. Core engine not modified.
spin_types reflect M31 production rawdata: ST=43 (paid), ST=44 (freespin bonus).
FreeSpin reel set defined separately in reel_strips.json as reel_set='freespin'.
The base SpinEngine is loaded with reel_set='base' (ST=43).
The plugin handles FreeSpin rounds internally with a second engine instance.
